statutes.name: Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022 (CCPA)
statutes.notes: Notified 9 June 2022. Clause 6 prohibits direct and indirect surrogate advertising. PROVISO: mere use of a brand or company name that is also used for a restricted product is not surrogate advertising if the ad is not otherwise objectionable. Sources disagree whether issued under Section 18 or 19 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019; check the gazette.
statutes.action_for_human: Open the PDF, copy clause 2(h) and clause 6 including the proviso, resolve the Section 18 vs 19 question.

statutes.name: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
statutes.provision: Section 5; COTPA Rules 2004, Rule 2(e) (definition of indirect advertisement)
statutes.notes: Section 5 bans direct and indirect tobacco advertising. Surrogate concept arrives through Rule 2(e), not Section 5 wording (noted by Delhi High Court in Vimal Elaichi matter). One commentary says pan masala is outside COTPA's definition of tobacco products; treat pan masala claims carefully (FSSAI rules may be the real basis).
statutes.action_for_human: Get Section 5 and Rule 2(e) from India Code or the MoHFW site. Decide whether pan masala entries need a different basis.

statutes.name: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 (Act 32 of 2025)
statutes.provision: Section 6 (prohibition of advertisement related to online money game); penalty Section 9(2)
statutes.replaced_from: MeitY Online Betting Advisory 2023 (could not be found under that name)
statutes.notes: Official text read. Section 6 covers ads that directly or indirectly promote or induce play of an online money game. Section 9(2): up to 2 years or fine up to Rs 50 lakh or both. Section 1(2): applies to services operated from outside India. 'Online money game' is defined irrespective of skill or chance. In force from 1 May 2026 (S.O. 1994(E), 22 April 2026). Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Rules 2026 also exist.

statutes.name: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 (RBI/2025-26/36, 8 May 2025)
statutes.provision: Key Fact Statement and APR disclosure provisions; applies to regulated entities and their lending service providers
statutes.notes: The 2022 guidelines were repealed by these Directions. The Directions bind regulated entities and LSPs, not advertisers in general, so they are a weak basis for 'no-document loan' ad claims. RBI reorganised circulars into Master Directions in November 2025; the current document number must be confirmed. KYC requirements sit in a separate KYC Master Direction (not yet researched).
statutes.action_for_human: Confirm the current RBI document, copy the KFS/APR clause, and find the KYC Master Direction clause if the team wants a basis for 'without KYC' claims.

statutes.name: Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 (Act 21 of 2019)
statutes.provision: Section 3(b) (no deposit taker shall promote or advertise an Unregulated Deposit Scheme); Section 5 (wrongful inducement)
statutes.replaced_from: SEBI Advertisement Code 2023 (does not exist under that name)
statutes.notes: Official text read. Applies to deposit takers and schemes that take deposits with a promise to return; does not by itself cover market-instrument return claims.

statutes.name: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
statutes.draft_url_seen: https://consumeraffairs.nic.in/sites/default/files/file-uploads/latestnews/Draft Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns 2023.pdf
statutes.notes: Notified 30 November 2023 under Section 18 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019. Annexure 1 (not 'Schedule 1') lists 13 specified dark patterns (some sources say 11; confirm). Annexure 1 states its illustrations are guidance, not a binding interpretation of law, so the product must not say 'violates CCPA penalties'. Only the DRAFT was seen on the official site; the notified gazette text is still needed.
statutes.action_for_human: Find the notified gazette text, copy the False Urgency definition and the Annexure 1 guidance caveat, confirm 13.

statutes.name: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
statutes.provision: Section 3(d) with the Schedule (54 entries); Section 4; Section 5
statutes.notes: Official text read, version as on 15 April 2026. One Schedule only. Schedule serials: Cancer 6, Diabetes 9, Obesity 38 (official text spells it 'Obsesity'), Rheumatism 43. Baldness and arthritis are NOT listed. Section 4 covers false or misleading claims about a drug. Section 5 covers magic remedies (talisman, mantra, kavacha). Section 3 applies to ads referring to a 'drug'.
statutes.action_for_human: Copy verbatim Section 3(d), 4, 5 and the Schedule rows 6, 9, 38, 43 from the PDF.

statutes.name: ASCI Code for Self-Regulation of Advertising Content in India
statutes.provision: Chapter III, clauses 3.5 and 3.6 (products whose advertising is prohibited by law)
statutes.notes: Self-regulatory code, not a statute. Clause numbers come from secondary sources only.
statutes.action_for_human: Check ascionline.in for the exact clause numbers.

statutes.name: SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices relating to Securities Market) Regulations, 2003
statutes.notes: SEBI orders and the appellate tribunal have treated promises of assured or guaranteed returns as violating regulations 3 and 4. Mutual fund advertisement code under the SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations 1996 also bars assuring returns (secondary source only).
statutes.action_for_human: Get the regulation text from sebi.gov.in.

entries.text: Paisa double formula bro 10 din me crorepati pakka guarantee!

entries.explanation: Slangy Hinglish get-rich-quick promise asserting guaranteed wealth doubling in 10 days.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Claims promising overnight riches or wealth multiplication are unlawful financial promotions.

entries.text: Our proprietary sovereign arbitrage program assures deterministic capital appreciation free from market fluctuations.

entries.ai_explanation_draft: Licensed NBFCs clearly disclosing regulatory registration and KYC obligations comply fully with norms.

entries.text: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; past performance does not assure future returns.

entries.ai_explanation_draft: Statutory investment risk disclosures meet established securities marketing guidelines.

entries.text: आरबीआई पंजीकृत बैंक से गृह ऋण हेतु आवश्यक केवाईसी दस्तावेज और आय प्रमाण पत्र जमा करें।

entries.ai_explanation_draft: Stating verified bank deposit interest rates with statutory insurance references is permissible.

entries.text: FlashSale alert! Sirf 5 minute bache hain! Jaldi cart checkout karo varna offer gayab!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Fabricates psychological panic with a 5-minute countdown timer threat.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Falsely creating a sense of urgency to mislead a user into making an immediate purchase is prohibited.

entries.text: The price doubles when this sixty-second countdown clock expires; complete purchase now or lose out!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Threatens an immediate price doubling based on an artificial sixty-second timer.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Presenting false countdown clocks that reset or misrepresent commercial price terms is a dark pattern.

entries.text: सिर्फ ३ मिनट शेष हैं! तुरंत ऑर्डर करें वरना विशेष छूट सदा के लिए समाप्त होगी।
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Devanagari script copy pressuring immediate checkout under threat of permanent expiration.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Creating false urgency in regional scripts through artificial time limits violates fair trading.

entries.text: Jaldi dabaa button bas 2 min baki hai loot le bhai!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Slangy Hinglish urgency prompt using panic cues to force impulse buying.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Coercive colloquial countdown prompts pressuring instant consumer transactions are prohibited.

entries.text: To ensure equitable allocation among guests, this subsidized tariff window remains accessible for only four minutes.
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Polite copy disguising a high-pressure 4-minute cart countdown behind guest equity language.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Coupling artificial short time windows with fairness claims constitutes deceptive scarcity design.

entries.text: Aakhri mauka! Mega bumper deal hamesha ke liye band ho jayegi aaj aadhi raat ko!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Manufactures false finality by claiming ongoing commercial deal will close forever at midnight.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Falsely stating that an offer will never be repeated or will be permanently cancelled is unlawful.

entries.text: Only two remaining seats exist in the entire nation; booking privileges will be revoked permanently.
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Falsely claims national inventory exhaustion to induce panic flight booking.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Manufacturing artificial scarcity regarding ticket availability is an actionable dark pattern.

entries.text: শেষ সুযোগ! এই অবিশ্বাস্য ডিসকাউন্ট প্যাকেজ চিরতরে বন্ধ হয়ে যাবে আর কখনো আসবে না।
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Bengali script copy claiming the discount package will be permanently terminated.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Deceptive scarcity claims in Indian regional languages constitute misleading practices under dark patterns guidance.

entries.text: Abhi le le varna jindagi bhar pachtayega mauka nikal gaya!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Uses psychological regret and FOMO phrasing to compel immediate purchase.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Exploiting consumer fear of missing out with coercive regret phrasing violates consumer rights.

entries.text: Regrettably, unmatched seasonal allowances of this magnitude cannot be honored once this session concludes.
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Polite copy disguising pressure tactics behind simulated browser session limits.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Simulating immediate session termination to bypass consumer deliberation is prohibited.

entries.text: Annual clearance sale valid at all retail outlets from November 1 through November 15, 2026.

entries.explanation: Clear, verifiable promotion window bounding with calendar dates and no panic language.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Clearly communicating verified commercial campaign start and conclusion dates is legitimate.

entries.text: Standard early bird registration window closes on Friday; regular delegate passes available thereafter.
entries.label: safe
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Legitimate conference ticketing schedule announcing subsequent regular tier availability.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Transparent tiered ticket pricing with scheduled transition dates is fully compliant.

entries.text: दिवाली विशेष छूट योजना १ नवंबर से ७ नवंबर २०२६ तक सभी शोरूम में उपलब्ध रहेगी।

entries.explanation: Safe Devanagari advertisement specifying transparent commercial dates without artificial panic.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Transparent regional commercial sale date disclosures comply with consumer guidelines.

entries.text: Flight seat availability updates in real time based on airline computer reservation system inventory.
entries.label: safe
entries.statute: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (CCPA)
entries.explanation: Factual disclosure explaining how airline seat availability is determined by reservation systems.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Factually truthful real-time inventory disclosures backed by technical data are permitted.

entries.text: MadhuMukti ras se diabetes ka 100% shartiya ilaj jad se khatam sirf 15 din me!

entries.statute: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
entries.explanation: Statutory offense claiming a 100% permanent cure for diabetes in 15 days.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: No person shall take any part in the publication of any advertisement referring to the diagnosis, cure or relief of diabetes.

entries.text: Completely cure chronic high blood sugar and eliminate all prescription medications forever with one drop.
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
entries.explanation: Claims permanent eradication of chronic blood sugar and total elimination of prescribed medication.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Advertisements asserting eradication of chronic scheduled lifestyle diseases are strictly prohibited.

entries.text: मधुमेह और गठिया का अचूक शर्तिया इलाज बिना किसी ऑपरेशन के जड़ से समाप्त।
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
entries.explanation: Devanagari script copy claiming a guaranteed root cure for diabetes and arthritis.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Publishing advertisements claiming guaranteed cure of arthritis or diabetes in Indian languages is unlawful.
entries.provision_override: Section 3(d); Schedule serial 9 (Diabetes). Arthritis is not scheduled (Rheumatism is serial 43)

entries.text: Sugar gayab 10 din me pakka ilaj dawa lo jhanjhat khatam!
entries.label: violation
entries.statute: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
entries.explanation: Slangy Hinglish promise claiming diabetes disappears in 10 days.
entries.ai_explanation_draft: Colloquial advertisements claiming miraculous disappearance of diabetes symptoms are prohibited by law.

entries.text: Our organic formulation restores pan-metabolic equilibrium, permanently eradicating advanced systemic diabetic degeneration.

entries.statute: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
entries.explanation: Polite pseudo-scientific copy asserting permanent eradication of diabetic degeneration.

entries.ai_explanation_draft: Advertising products claiming magical or effortless reduction of obesity violates statutory prohibitions for scheduled conditions.

entries.text: Guarantee complete baldness reversal and sprout thick dense black hair follicles in forty-eight hours.

entries.provision_override: Section 4 (false claim about a drug). Baldness is not on the Schedule

entries.text: அதிசய மூலிகை எண்ணெய் ஏழு நாட்களில் வழுக்கையை போக்கி புதிய கூந்தலை வளர்க்கும்.
